## About this round

MARL 14th-cohort accelerator selection; Disrupt Africa (published 2026-10-21T09:00:49Z) reports each of Solarcorp, Bravoo and Zendtrax receiving US$50,000 in funding; Demo Day 12 Nov 2026. The article does not state the instrument. MARL's own FAQ describes an initial $50,000 for 5% equity, not verified for this cohort. Date is the article publication date used as the announcement date.
